newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to issue 1.8 trln won monetary bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to issue 1.8 trln won monetary bonds.

text.p: The Bank of Korea has decided to issue 1.8 trillion won worth of one-year monetary stabilisation bonds on Saturday, a central bank official said on Friday.
"A total of 1.34 trillion won worth of monetary stabilisation bonds would mature on Saturday so the new issue would absorb 300 billion won from the system," the official said.
The central bank decided to issue the bonds to absorb excess market liquidity following the inflow of foreign funds for equity investment. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
